summary: Analyzer that passes audio through untouched and shows its spectrum (FFT with peak hold, third-octave bars), loudness (momentary, short-term and integrated LUFS, loudness range, true peak) and stereo image (correlation, width, goniometer). Use it anywhere in a chain to watch a signal; machine_readings returns its numbers, which are the analysis library's (analyze measures the same way).
use_for: Watch the spectrum of any signal, with peak hold, without changing it.

parameters.name: Smoothing
parameters.description: Width of the band each point of the spectrum curve sums: narrow resolves single tones; 1/3 oct draws through the third-octave bars
parameters.how: Sets how wide a slice of the spectrum each point of the curve adds up, from 1/24 octave (fine) to 1/3 octave (broad).
parameters.sound: Fine settings show single tones and harmonics as sharp spikes; broad ones draw a smooth curve that reads as overall tonal balance.

parameters.name: Speed
parameters.description: How fast the spectrum follows the signal: averaging over about 0.1, 0.3, 1 or 3 s
parameters.how: Sets how long the spectrum averages the signal: about 0.1, 0.3, 1 or 3 seconds.
parameters.sound: Fast follows every note and hit; slow settles into a steady picture of the track's average tone.

parameters.name: Peak hold
parameters.description: How long peaks hold before they fall: the spectrum's peak curve and bars, and the true-peak marker
parameters.how: Sets how long the peak curve, the bars and the true-peak marker stay up before they fall, from 0.25 to 20 seconds.
parameters.sound: The audio does not change; short holds follow the music, long ones keep the loudest moments on screen.

parameters.name: Tilt
parameters.description: Display slope around 1 kHz (the readings never tilt): 0 shows pink noise flat, 3 shows a typical finished mix about flat, 4.5 leans brighter
parameters.how: Tilts the displayed spectrum around 1 kHz by 0, 3 or 4.5 dB per octave, without touching the audio or the readings.
parameters.sound: At 3 dB per octave a typical finished mix looks about flat, which makes its balance easier to judge by eye.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description: The loudness (LUFS, written in dB) the meters are coloured against: −14 for streaming, −23 for broadcast
parameters.how: Sets the loudness in LUFS that the meters are coloured against, from -36 to 0; -14 suits streaming, -23 broadcast.
parameters.sound: The audio does not change; the meters show how far the track sits above or below the target.

parameters.name: Reset
parameters.description: On: the integrated loudness, loudness range, maxima and held peaks start again. Turn it Off, then On, for the next reset
parameters.how: Switching it on restarts the integrated loudness, the loudness range, the maxima and the held peaks.
parameters.sound: The audio does not change; the long-term figures start counting again from zero.
